items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: You've got Oscar Markwood says here on the fiddle.

ctx.x: Yeah, I know that, he still goes to them. He sees there in the front row every time there's a fight here in town. He never misses one. Oh Pete. Oh, he's amazing. You've got Oscar Markwood says here on the fiddle. Yeah, that's a fiddle.
That's a jazz fiddle. That's not no regular fiddle, no straight fiddle, that's a jazz fiddle.
